messages.subject: Question related to Output part 2
parts:
Hi Vincent, Jairo and everyone,

I have a question related to Person level summary and Day level summary for Output part 2.
If we need to get an average for 7-days output, should we use day level summary?
More specifically, there is a difference between average of 7 days MX metrics in day level summary and MX metric in person level.

Thank you in advance and kind regards,
Hana

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Question related to Output part 2
parts:
Hi Hana,

I am not sure I understand your question. GGIR does not generate 7-day summaries.
Please be specific about the variable names you are comparing and any other detail about your data or analysis that could help us understand the issue.

For most GGIR reports recording level averages are provided as a plain average and as a weighted average. All of which should be reproducible from the day/night level values. GGIR directly used those day/night level reports to generate the recording (person) level summary.

Thanks,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Question related to Output part 2
parts:
Sorry, I still do not understand your question. The file you sent has a name that GGIR does not create and you refer to it as daysummary but I only shows recording level summary variables in it.

GGIR stores a file part2_daysummary.csv with day level estimates and part2_summary.csv with recording.csv level estimates including the weighted summary to reflect a typical week.
I do not understand why you are not just using those estimates.

Vincent
